categories.main_business_segments: Zhuzhou Feilu High-tech Materials Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the development, production, sales, and services of anti-corrosion and waterproof materials for metal, non-metal, and concrete surfaces, as well as new energy sectors. Its main business segments include anti-corrosion coatings, waterproof materials, photovoltaic module encapsulation materials, and new energy thermal management materials. The company also provides integrated coating and painting services, coating construction, and photovoltaic power station EPC contracting, serving industries such as rail transit equipment manufacturing and maintenance, civil construction, wind power equipment manufacturing, and photovoltaic EPC projects.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes proprietary technology in water-based resins, water-based coatings, and other functional coatings, with numerous patents in these areas. It employs advanced manufacturing processes for high-solid, solvent-free, and environmentally friendly coatings, including polyurethane, fluorocarbon, acrylic, epoxy, and modified bitumen waterproof membranes. The firm integrates product development with on-site application technologies, offering coating and painting integrated solutions. It also invests in intelligent factory construction for encapsulation materials and adhesive tapes, enhancing production capacity and quality control.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include large state-owned enterprises and central enterprises in rail transit (e.g., China Railway Group, China Railway Construction Corporation, CRRC), real estate developers (e.g., China Resources Land, China Railway Real Estate Group), and new energy companies involved in wind power, photovoltaic, and energy storage projects. The company serves markets in rail transit equipment manufacturing and maintenance, rail transit engineering construction, civil and municipal construction, and new energy sectors such as wind and solar power.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within China, with significant business in regions including South China, Central China, East China, North China, and Southwest China. It has production bases and subsidiaries in cities such as Zhuzhou, Changsha, Guangzhou, Shenzhen, Xiamen, and Liling. The company also exports products, with some rail transit coating projects in Brazil and other international markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Zhuzhou Feilu operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on the research, development, and manufacturing of high-performance coatings, waterproof materials, adhesives, and related products. It also provides integrated coating application services and EPC contracting for photovoltaic power stations, positioning itself as a comprehensive solution provider in protective materials and services for rail transit, construction, and new energy industries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in water-based and environmentally friendly coatings, development of new energy materials such as photovoltaic encapsulation films and adhesives, and expansion of EPC contracting capabilities in wind, solar, and energy storage projects. It invests in intelligent manufacturing facilities and emphasizes cross-industry technology integration. R&D efforts focus on proprietary resin technologies, functional coatings for anti-corrosion and waterproofing, and high-end adhesive materials for new energy applications, supported by a strong team of over 90 R&D personnel and multiple patents.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through direct product sales of coatings, waterproof materials, adhesives, and related products. Additional revenue streams include integrated coating and painting services, standalone coating construction services, and EPC contracting for photovoltaic power stations. Sales are mainly conducted via direct sales and bidding processes, targeting large state-owned and central enterprises.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic player in the rail transit anti-corrosion and waterproof materials market, recognized as the first listed company in this niche. It holds a strong market position with advanced technology and extensive customer relationships. In the building waterproofing sector, it is a challenger focusing on high-quality projects with central and state-owned enterprises. In the new energy sector, it is a fast-growing follower leveraging its coating and adhesive technology to capture market share amid increasing competition.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 825 million, a 24.19% increase year-over-year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 20.67 million, reversing previous losses. The company’s total assets stood at about RMB 1.82 billion with steady growth. It has shown significant recovery and growth momentum, especially in new energy and rail transit sectors, supported by increased sales volumes and expanded production capacity.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Zhuzhou Feilu emphasizes its comprehensive product portfolio covering anti-corrosion, waterproofing, and new energy materials with proprietary technologies and patents. It differentiates through environmentally friendly, high-solid, and solvent-free coatings, integrated product and application solutions, and strong customer service capabilities. The company’s early market entry and deep technical expertise in rail transit coatings provide a competitive edge, while its strategic expansion into new energy materials and EPC services offers growth potential and diversified customer value.
